M006_reason: Existing underside bearing ledges reduce unsupported floor span from 564 to 504 mm. Removing this support increases one-way strip bending stress by 25.2% and deflection by 56.8% under the same distributed load. Actual floor loading and plywood qualification are unresolved; do not assert redundancy.

pockets.note: Original geometric packaging study; not a Kreg specification. Floor pockets require underside access before M006 installation. No permanent pocket geometry or pilot diameter released.

monitor_rail.hardware: M6-family captive thread, adjustable support with replaceable polymer contact, locking nut; purchased dimensions HOLD
monitor_rail.attachment: Two rear-driven retention screws; captured end shoulders carry vertical load. Pilot, screw length and head selected before machining.
monitor_rail.main_display_retention: Existing four positive through-bolts unchanged; rail is adjustment support only.

underfront_controls.display: Unlocated schematic inset only; no final coordinates or bores

cradle_reason: Upper guide wall stiffness is not proven preserved by candidate trimming; minimum root alone is insufficient evidence.
